_doc: Moonroot Grove: the strip north of Azure Coast and east of the Frontier's north (global x -160..210, z -237..-120), from the owner's concept panorama: a moon-stone camp in the west, a fern path, the Mirror Pond in the middle and an old stone ring in the east. Same schema as data/world.json. Seams: maxZ meets Azure Coast, minX meets the Frontier. Level band 6-10 bridges Azure (1-8) and the Frontier forest (10-12).

acceptedScenes._doc: Accepted scenes placed in this region (data/accepted-scenes, scene.region): the five Moonroot Grove zones west to east as the region concept lays them out (owner, 26 October 2026). Same settings as data/world.json acceptedScenes; coordinates are this map's local metres.

apron._doc: Outer apron (core/accepted-scenes.js acceptedApronOffsets): native ground in a ring outside these scene sides is raised or lowered to meet the scene's edge, so a high rim meets the world on a slope no steeper than 1/k instead of dropping inside the 5 m feather. Ring width = clamp(k*rise, min, max) m; the edge rise is smoothed smoothAlong m along the side. Sides left out face the map edge, the sea, the city or a neighbouring scene too close for a slope.

acceptedScenes.grassBanksDoc: Scenes whose rock faces are their own meshes: the ground's slope paint keeps grass on their steep banks instead of painting grey strata (render/ground.js aBank).

foliage.chunkDoc: Each scene's instanced plants (crowns, trunks, shrubs, flowers, fronds) are split into chunk-metre square pieces, as the map's own plants are, so the camera and the sun's shadow box draw only the pieces they reach. Grass keeps its own per-clump culling.
foliage._doc: In the game the scenes' trees, shrubs and grass are the map's own (render/accepted-scenes.js): the game's geometry, palette and materials, crowns in the map's proportions and tint. Ordinary trees: each scene's authored sizes (world scale of the trunk's width) times treeScale[scene], which brings its typical tree near the map's (median 0.9; the forest's a little larger) and keeps its own variation. bigTrees stay big: the tree nearest 'at' (world x, z, within 1 m) takes 'size' (world scale; the map's largest ordinary tree is about 1.14). Colliders keep the scene data. Moonroot's scenes keep their authored sizes (treeScale 1): their roots are drawn for those trunks.

surround._doc: The ring outside each accepted scene where the town's earth clearing and soil patches give way to grass (render/ground.js, ui/mapimage.js); the grass keeps the map's own zone colours, in the scenes too. Distances in metres from the scene bounds; keep corridors leave routes and waypoint clearings earth.

plant._doc: Scene-surround planting (core/world.js plantSceneSurrounds): trees (collision circles of type scene-tree) and shrubs (decor.sceneShrubs) in a ring outside each accepted scene, kept off roads, waypoints, beaches and water, with one seed per scene placed after every native pass. Shrubs grow in clumps (clump: shrubs per clump, within clumpRadius m), treeBase of them at a ring tree's foot. Distances in metres outside the bounds.
